interaction_window_proxy.note: Transparent word/action count from community step text; not the exact number of legal opponent priority windows.

limitations: Commander Spellbook is community-maintained and is not an official Comprehensive Rules/rulings source.
Zone mentions are word counts in prerequisites/notes/steps, not normalized per-piece zone requirements.
Declared mana is preserved from Spellbook's mana_needed field; blank does not mean zero mana.
The stack-action proxy counts textual cast/activate/trigger/resolve actions and is not a priority-window simulator.

produces: Opponents put all cards in hand on the bottom of their library on each of their draw steps
raw.steps:
At the beginning of your opponent's draw step, after they draw their card, Teferi's Puzzle Box triggers, causing them to put the cards in their hand on the bottom of their library, then attempt to draw that many cards.
Notion Thief's replacement effect causes you to draw that many cards instead.
Repeat on each opponent's draw step.
